description: Compute account balance from journal postings with optional client/dimension/date filters. With date_from, `balance` / `debit_total` / `credit_total` are the period figures; `opening_balance_at_date_from`, `period_net` and `closing_balance` give the balance before the window and at its end. `group_by: "client"` adds per-client rows (journal header client; journals without one form a clients_id null row).

account_id.description: Account id from list_accounts. In the RIK chart the id is the account number itself (e.g. 2110, 8900).

accounts_dimensions_id.description: Filter to one dimension (sub-account) of the account, e.g. the Wise dimension of 1020. Dimension id from list_account_dimensions; must belong to account_id.

group_by.description: "client": also return per-client rows (by journal header client) next to the unchanged totals. Not combinable with clients_id.

include_entries.description: Include individual entries in response (default false)

name: compute_account_balance
title: Compute Account Balance
